# mimikyu (by Saengil)

> High-speed native Rust agentic browser runtime, two-tier session/profile isolation layer, warm Unix-socket daemon, and 33-tool MCP control plane driving local Chromium (CDP) and Firefox (W3C WebDriver BiDi).

- Latest Release: v0.2.0 (2026-11-20)
- Release Notes: https://github.com/YXZYSME/mimikyu/releases/tag/v0.2.0
- Website: https://mimikyu.saengil.ai
- Repository: https://github.com/YXZYSME/mimikyu
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- Author / Brand: Saengil / YXZYSME
- MCP Registry ID: io.github.YXZYSME/mimikyu (MCP Protocol 2024-11-05)
- MSRV: Rust 1.88+ (Edition 2024)

## Key Capabilities & Measured Performance

- **~5.0 ms semantic `@eN` snapshots** (Chromium CDP; `19.0 ms` on Firefox BiDi; local `127.0.0.1` loopback benchmark medians) across open Shadow DOM and nested/cross-origin iframes.
- **2.79x–3.57x token compression** (967 -> 347 est. tokens on Chromium CDP; 967 -> 271 est. tokens on Firefox BiDi).
- **~5.4 ms Markdown extraction** (`5.5 ms` on Firefox BiDi) and **~67.1 ms warm virtual contexts** (Tier 2 `VirtualContextPool`, local loopback benchmark medians).
- **Dual-Engine Native Drivers**: Native WebSocket Chromium DevTools Protocol (`driver::cdp`) and W3C WebDriver BiDi (`driver::bidi`) behind a strict `DriverSession` trait boundary.
- **Managed Browsers & Privacy Vault**: Built-in `mimikyu browser install` (SHA-256 verified Chrome-for-Testing & Firefox), `mimikyu vault launch`, curated DNS-boundary tracker blocking (`--block-trackers`), and headless CDP screencast recording (`mimikyu record`).
- **Two-Tier Isolation**: Tier 1 `fs2`-locked persistent profiles (`--profile`) or self-cleaning ephemeral directories (`--ephemeral`), plus Tier 2 warm pooled virtual browser contexts (`--virtual`).
- **Coherent Environment Profiles & ProxyRelay**: Built-in `win11`, `macos`, `linux` presets, offline GeoIP alignment (`--geoip`), and an embedded local `127.0.0.1:0` `ProxyRelay` (`--proxy`) supporting authenticated HTTP/SOCKS5 upstreams without exposing credentials in browser flags.
- **33 Turnkey MCP Tools**: 13 `mimikyu_*` tools (including R3-compliant human-in-the-loop takeover) + 20 `browser_*` tools over stdio JSON-RPC 2.0.
- **Verified Suite**: 372 Rust tests (345 mimikyu-core + 26 mimikyu-cli + 1 mimikyu; 0 Clippy warnings) + 237 opaque-box Python E2E tests / 244 runs (5/5 agentic workflows passing on both Chromium and Firefox).

## Official Package Registries

- Shell (`curl`, SHA-256 + SLSA v1): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YXZYSME/mimikyu/main/install.sh | sh`
- Homebrew (`YXZYSME/homebrew-tap`): `brew tap YXZYSME/tap && brew trust yxzysme/tap && brew install mimikyu`
- Rust (`crates.io` / `binstall`): `cargo install mimikyu-cli` or `cargo binstall mimikyu-cli` or `cargo add mimikyu`
- Node (`npm` / `npx`): `npm install -g saengil-mimikyu` or `npx -y saengil-mimikyu doctor` or `npx -y mimikyu-mcp`
- Python (`PyPI` / `uvx`): `pip install mimikyu` or `uvx mimikyu doctor` or `uvx --from mimikyu mimikyu-mcp`

## MCP Client Configuration

### npx (zero global install)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mimikyu": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mimikyu-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### uvx (zero global install)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mimikyu": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": ["--from", "mimikyu", "mimikyu-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Local binary
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mimikyu": {
      "command": "mimikyu",
      "args": ["mcp", "--engine", "chromium"]
    }
  }
}
```

## 33 MCP Tools

### `mimikyu_*` Namespace (13 tools)
- `mimikyu_session_new`: Create a new isolated browser session
- `mimikyu_session_close`: Close an active browser session and clean up its resources
- `mimikyu_open`: Navigate an existing session to a URL
- `mimikyu_snapshot`: Capture a compact @eN semantic accessibility tree snapshot
- `mimikyu_click`: Click an element by @eN ref or CSS selector
- `mimikyu_fill`: Clear and fill a form field by @eN ref or CSS selector
- `mimikyu_extract`: Extract structured content (markdown, text, links, or tables) from the current page
- `mimikyu_wait`: Wait for page idle, text, URL substring, or selector state
- `mimikyu_batch`: Execute an ordered sequence of browser actions in a single call
- `mimikyu_eval`: Evaluate JavaScript in isolated world or opt-in main world
- `mimikyu_screenshot`: Capture a PNG screenshot of the viewport, full page, or target element
- `mimikyu_request_human_takeover`: Pause all automated session operations and hand control to a human operator (for interactive login, 2FA, or manual review); returns a takeover_id required to resume
- `mimikyu_resume_from_human`: Resume automated session operations after a human operator confirms takeover completion with the active takeover_id

### `browser_*` Namespace (20 tools)
- `browser_open`, `browser_close`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_click`, `browser_fill`, `browser_type`, `browser_press`, `browser_select`, `browser_upload`, `browser_scroll`, `browser_eval`, `browser_extract`, `browser_screenshot`, `browser_wait`, `browser_batch`, `browser_context_list`, `browser_context_close`, `browser_profile_export`, `browser_profile_import`, `browser_env_report`

## Scope & R3 Compliance Boundary

`mimikyu` is strictly a general-purpose AI-agent browser automation, session/profile isolation, and environment consistency runtime. It intentionally excludes any CAPTCHA solver, human-verification challenge bypass, proof-of-work circumvention, or anti-bot gate bypass functionality. Human-in-the-loop takeover (`mimikyu_request_human_takeover` / `mimikyu_resume_from_human`) pauses automation so a human can complete legitimate login, 2FA, payment, or verification steps directly.
